terms.comment: Lewis & Short: heri is perhaps the only form in Cicero; here is the usual one after the Augustan age (Quint. 1.7.22).

evidence: Ov. Fast. 5.506: ignis in hesternō stīpite parvus erat
terms.comment: hesternō diē is “yesterday” too (Cic. N. D. 2.73, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: ignis in hesternō stīpite parvus erat
phrases.english: a small fire was still burning in yesterday’s log

sources: Lewis & Short: heri · Lewis & Short: hesternus
